item.title: Trac+Perforce
item.description: People who are using Trac and have a need of possibility binding it with Perforce repository can find that appropriate plugin is dead and no support is possible. So I would like to do some refresh – I was able to do some fixing and made these plugins available for use with Trac 1.0 for win32. Attaching to the post. pyprotocols-0.9.3-py2.7-win32 PyPerforce-0.4-py2.7-win32 TracPerforce-0.5dev-py2.7
